title: Claude status page reports elevated errors on requests to multiple models
date_note: Date is the incident's day on Anthropic's status page.
geo_basis: service-wide incident; the status page states no location
summary: Anthropic's status page lists an incident titled elevated errors for multiple models on 23 November. According to Anthropic, the models affected were Claude Mythos 5.2, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5 and other models, and the services were claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Anthropic's page records the issue as identified, a fix deployed and then resolved.
plain: Anthropic's status page says requests to several Claude models returned more errors than normal on 23 November. The incident is marked resolved.
exec: A Claude service disruption affected claude.ai, the API, Claude Code and Cowork, per Anthropic's status page.
impact: Elevated error rates on Claude models and services, per the status page.

validation.note: Anthropic's own status page, read in this run.

review.note: title, date, models, services and resolved status compared with Anthropic status page
